messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries on global warming you might enjoy:

| Title | Year | Director | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and urges urgent action. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Fisher Stevens (producer) | Leonardo DiCaprio explores the impacts of climate change worldwide and discusses solutions. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conner | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2020 | Various | A concise, data‑driven overview of climate science and policy options. |
| **Our Planet** (Season 1) | 2019 | David Attenborough | While not solely about climate change, it highlights how warming threatens ecosystems and wildlife. |

If you have a particular focus (e.g., marine life, policy, personal stories) or a preferred release year, let me know and I can narrow down the list further!
